This classic men's cologne opens with brisk, cool calabrian bergamot, green tangerine and neroli, and gradually grows deeper and richer with notes of rose, rosemary, jasmine petal, persimmon, and Indonesian patchouli.  Fantastic for spring and summer wear in casual and work settings, this scent is as timeless as a white tee and well worn jeans, and the men who wear it are professional, warm, and friendly.
